Whether decorated with coordinating ornaments for a sophisticated look or colourful baubles for a playful festive display, this versatile tree makes a striking centrepiece for living rooms and seasonal celebrations. wxnpzb6b.baseName: Walplus 452 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
wxnpzb6b.variantName: Walplus 452 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
wxnpzb6b.sourceDescription: This beautiful artificial hinged Christmas tree is very lifelike in its shape and appearance and is meant to create just the right atmosphere for this Christmas. Hinged construction: The Christmas tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down at the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape and will save you time as well.Sturdy stand: The iron stand provides your artificial Christmas tree with optimal sturdiness and stability.Flocked snow design: The Christmas ornament has artificial white snow on it, giving an attractive snow-flocked look.Economical choice: You can reuse the holiday ornament every year, which is a cost-effective option compared to getting a real tree. Good to know:We recommend setting aside 30-45 minutes after assembly to properly shape the tree by peeling back the branches and pulling the tips apart to give the branches a more full-bodied look. Product Specifications Tree colour: Green and white Material: PVC (polyvinylchloride), iron Total height: 180 cm Bottom diameter: 75 cm Stand size: 40 x 15 cm (W x H) Hinged construction With 452 PVC tips Decorated with flocked snow Suitable for sheltered areas such as roofs, balconies, canopies, etc. Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Artificial hinged Christmas tree 1 x Stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

wxjv4pan.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Arbor Ultima Christmas Tree
wxjv4pan.sourceDescription: Goodbye gappy trees! The Arbor Ultima has top-of-the-range realism and nearly 1,000 high-grade branch tips in a full and bushy artificial tree. One of our highest quality traditional Christmas trees, the Arbor Ultima is a fantastic choice for those who look for full foliage in their tree. With a stunning conifer silhouette and high number of masterfully created PVC & PE branch tips, you get the realistic look, while the fresh "new-shoot green" colour give this design a real feel. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 7ft • Number of Branch Tips: 2702 PE/PVC branch tips • Tree Width: 116cm diameter • Foliage colour: Two-tone "New-shoot" green • Realistic look: A mix of ultra-realistic plastic moulded tips, with traditional PVC tips to fill out any gaps • Easy assembly: Attached Hinged Branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire-resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The trees construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

qxb00bvt.baseName: Christmas Tree World 100cm Blue Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
qxb00bvt.variantName: Christmas Tree World 100cm Blue Metallic Inflatable Mirror Ball - Pack of 1
qxb00bvt.sourceDescription: Introducing the 100cm Inflatable Mirror Display Ball in Blue, a striking and versatile decorative solution designed to create instant impact in retail environments, commercial venues, events, exhibitions, and the home. Featuring a sleek mirror finish, this inflatable display ball reflects light and surroundings beautifully, making it ideal for eye-catching shop windows, visual merchandising, brand activations, and large-scale installations. A key advantage for commercial users is ease of storage. Once deflated or with the air removed using a compatible electric pump the display ball folds down to a fraction of its inflated size, making off-season storage simple and space-efficient. Manufactured from fire-retardant materials, the Inflatable Mirror Display Ball is suitable for use in commercial and public spaces. It is inflated once, sealed securely, and displayed without the need for a continuous power supply. Product Features • Size: 100cm (other sizes available) • Colour: Blue (other colours available) • Finish: High-gloss mirror effect • Material: Durable inflatable construction • Fire-resistant: Fire retardant material • Indoor & outdoor use • Installation options: Floor-standing, ceiling-hung, wall-mounted or secured to ground • Inflation: Inflated once and sealed no continuous air supply required • Storage: Fully deflates to take up minimal storage space • Pump: Electric air pump not included • Oversized gold bauble caps not included • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests.
